name: extract a digit grid from an image file
definition: Read an image and recognize the 9x9 arrangement of printed digits (OCR/vision) into a structured numeric grid.
failure_mode: Misrecognized digits cause the solved puzzle to diverge from the true solution.

name: generate a jpeg-format file
definition: Create a JPEG-format file containing rendered raster content with a different target phrase.

name: locate the framework template-rendering path that evaluates untrusted input
definition: Navigate the vendored web-framework source to find where a user-supplied string is passed into the template engine as a template to be executed.
failure_mode: Wrong layer modified leaves the vulnerable path active

name: modify framework rendering so supplied input is emitted as plain text rather than executed as a template
definition: Change the framework's behavior so a user-provided value is escaped/treated as literal text, preventing template-expression and code execution while still echoing the raw text.
failure_mode: Input still evaluated (expression executed) or empty response fails checks
